def smooth_polyline(points: np.ndarray, spacing_px: float = 3.0):
    delta = np.diff(points, axis=0)
    seg = np.linalg.norm(delta, axis=1)
    s = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(seg)]
    spline = CubicSpline(s, points, axis=0, bc_type='natural')
    ss = np.arange(0, s[-1], spacing_px)
    if len(ss) == 0 or ss[-1] < s[-1]:

    xy = spline(ss)
    tangent = spline(ss, 1)
    tangent /= np.maximum(1e-9, np.linalg.norm(tangent, axis=1))[:, None]
